metadata.title: Day Ahead Residential Energy Forecasting
metadata.subtitle: Comparative Modelling and Portfolio Prediction
metadata.target: Received Total interval energy, interpreted as electricity grid import
metadata.evidenceStatus: Saved Approach A outputs; source-code and published-report evidence for Approach B

dataQuality.note: Missing Total values in supplied rows and timestamps absent from files are distinct quantities. No missing actuals are filled with zero.

A.name: Approach A
A.overview: Forecast weather, then household demand; aggregate 410 household profiles; calibrate demand uncertainty; simulate cost-based purchasing.
cleaning: Validate household identifiers and unique on-grid UTC timestamps; require finite numeric readings.
Check Total = heat-pump component + other component on complete rows.
Reconstruct missing Total only if both components are valid; zero rows met this rule in the supplied data.
Preserve measured zeros and extremes; exclude rows without a usable target from training and scoring.
Keep numeric metadata missing with missing indicators; categorical equipment values use True / False / Unknown.
features: Building, heating and domestic hot-water metadata
A.coldStart: Separate history-free demand model retains available metadata and weather; used for the four homes without Total history. Their true accuracy cannot be measured.

protocol.issue: 11:00 Europe/Berlin on the day before delivery
protocol.meterCutoff: Interval start at or before issue minus 30 minutes
protocol.weatherCutoff: Hourly start at or before issue minus two hours
protocol.testFit: Selected on validation, then refitted once on eligible training + validation labels; weights frozen throughout the test
protocol.rollingInputs: Earlier measured test history may update later features without updating model weights
protocol.availability: Unavailable boundary labels embargoed; fixed undated metadata assumed known historically
protocol.fitSampling: deterministic 1/8 rotating slots plus all extreme flags

A.selection: matched-support portfolio WAPE; household MAE tie-break

B.name: Approach B
B.overview: Pool eligible household rows, fit a linear demand model, calibrate Ridge interval uncertainty, and fill unsupported household forecasts with fallbacks.
cleaning: Coerce timestamps and targets; drop observations with invalid timestamps or missing targets.
Sort rows, keep the first duplicate timestamp, and reindex a regular UTC 15-minute grid.
Keep gaps missing; omit training/calibration rows missing the target or any required feature.
Retain every household in the final forecast; clip predictions and fallback values nonnegative.
features: Sine and cosine of time of day
B.scaling: StandardScaler fitted only on pre-calibration training rows

protocol.fit: Refit a pooled global Ridge model separately for each target date
protocol.training: At least 1,344 complete pre-calibration rows per eligible home
protocol.calibration: Exactly 1,344 complete rows in the immediately preceding 14 days; excluded from model/scaler fit
protocol.futureFeatures: All 96 future one-day and one-week lag pairs must exist
protocol.latestInputs: Complete preceding UTC day through 23:45 UTC; later information than A's issue cutoff
protocol.uncertainty: Split conformal absolute-residual intervals; nominal marginal 80% for Ridge household-quarter-hour forecasts

benchmark.name: Validation-selected 75/25 lag blend
benchmark.definition: 75% previous-available matching local-slot demand + 25% previous-week matching local-slot demand

metrics.label: Portfolio interval root mean squared error

annualPerformance.interpretation: Approach A improves household MAE by 7.67% and RMSE by 16.09%; portfolio interval WAPE improves by 0.175 percentage points (1.21% relative). Daily-total MAE is 3.56% worse.
annualPerformance.support: Every A/lag-blend pair uses the identical measured household and interval support; observed households vary across dates.

dailySeries.note: Matched series are null for 29 October; fullForecastMWh uses all active homes and is not directly comparable to matched actuals.

dayProfiles.note: Exact totals come from the comparison CSV. Curve values are saved six-decimal presentation extracts, unsmoothed; residual = forecast minus actual.

B.verification: published report values; numeric household predictions unavailable

historicalComparison.note: Different observed household supports and issue cutoffs: descriptive reported results, not a controlled A-versus-B ranking.
historicalComparison.provenanceCaveat: B numeric household forecast exports are absent. The current B code scores historical portfolios only if all 410 actual profiles exist, so it does not reproduce these published subset rows. The updated B document instead lists 368/381/374 complete actual profiles; artifact relationships are not independently established.

A.dailyQuantiles: Separately calibrated daily residual quantiles; not sums of interval quantiles

B.verification: latest report-stated total; code eligibility verified; numeric output missing

finalForecast.note: Both point forecasts cover 410 homes. No measured target-day actuals were supplied, so final-day error and realized savings cannot be calculated.

A.method: Validation residual calibration; separately calibrate portfolio intervals and daily totals
A.full410Status: Provisional; includes unverified proxy residuals for four targetless homes

B.method: Split conformal, higher finite-sample quantile of pooled absolute calibration errors

uncertainty.note: Nominal and measured coverage are distinct. Neither approach establishes simultaneous coverage of all 96 intervals. Daily quantiles do not generally add.

weather.note: Demand-model inputs are predicted weather; realized target-day weather is not used. Units differ, so MAE values should not be compared across weather variables.

featureStudy.note: Cumulative feature-group comparisons for one configuration; not causal feature importance. Recent + PV adds photovoltaic information to the recent-demand design. The lag blend scored better on validation portfolio WAPE.

caveats: Approach A versus its own lag blend is a measured comparison; Approach B is a separate Ridge approach.
Published A/B historical rows have different supports and timing; a controlled model ranking is unavailable.
Measured targetless-home demand is absent; true accuracy for the four homes is unknown.
Daily-total MAE did not improve despite household and interval WAPE improvements.
Europe/Berlin timing and historical availability of the fixed undated metadata are benchmark assumptions.
No actual demand exists for 28 February 2024 in the supplied files.
No actual electricity price series, purchase execution or euro savings is demonstrated.
